description: The order amount must always be populated.
logic_definition: No row in orders where amount is NULL or blank. SQL: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount IS NULL OR TRIM(amount) = '';
remediation_action: Contact the source owner to fill in the missing field.

description: The order status must belong to the allowed list of values.
logic_definition: status belongs to the allowed set. SQL: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('PENDING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED');
remediation_action: Fix the value or update the value reference list.

description: An order identifier must not be duplicated.
logic_definition: No duplicate on (order_id). SQL: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
remediation_action: Deduplicate at the source and investigate the root cause.

description: Every order must reference an existing customer (foreign key).
logic_definition: Every customer_id in orders exists in customers.customer_id. SQL: SELECT s.* FROM orders s LEFT JOIN customers r ON s.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.customer_id IS NULL;
remediation_action: Check the synchronisation of the customer reference data.

description: The order date must not exceed the expected freshness threshold (T+3).
logic_definition: order_date is not older than 3 day(s) relative to today. SQL: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3' DAY;
remediation_action: Investigate the delay in the EUC data feed.

description: The amount declared in the EUC must match the reference system.
logic_definition: Value of amount reconciled between orders and orders_reference (tolerance 0.5%). SQL: SELECT * FROM orders s FULL OUTER JOIN orders_reference r ON s.order_id = r.order_id WHERE s.order_id IS NULL OR r.order_id IS NULL OR ABS(s.amount - r.amount) / NULLIF(r.amount, 0) * 100 > 0.5;
remediation_action: Escalate to the Finance team to investigate the gap.

control_name: Region must be a known code
description: The region code must belong to the served countries (FR, BE, DE).
logic_definition: region belongs to the allowed set. SQL: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE region NOT IN ('FR', 'BE', 'DE');
remediation_action: Fix the region code at the source or extend the country reference list.
